senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone.
2 Known, understood.
3 Obtained, gained.
4 Lost.
n. (-तं)
Going, motion.
2 Any thing past or done, an event.
E.
गम to go, in the participle past.

n. (-लं)
Time past.
E.
गत, and काल time.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Rested, refreshed.
E.
गत, and क्लम fatigue.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Senseless, swooned.
E.
गत, and चेतना consciousness.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Well, recovered, free from fever or sickness^1.
E.
गत, and ज्वर fever.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Cloudless, cleared up, fair.
E.
गत, and तोयद a cloud.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Returned, come back again after having gone away.
E.
गत, and प्रत्य, गत come back.

n. (-नं)
Yesterday.
E.
गत, and दिन day; also गतदिवसं.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Agitated, discomposed, unsteady.
E.
गत, and धृति firmness.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Noseless.
E.
गत gone, lost, and नासिका the nose.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Reformed, without deceit.
2 Cruel without compassion.
E.
गत, and माया deceit.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unfortunate, suffering losses; so गतदीक.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Going, passing.
2 Obtaining.
3 Falling into.
4 Feeling, entertaining.
E.
गम, and क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Beggared, impoverished.
E.
गत, and वित्त wealth.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Poor, indigent.
E.
गत, and विभव wealth.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Free from pain.
2 Unanxious.
E.
गत, and व्यथ pain.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Grown up, above eight years of age. गत, and शैशव infancy.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Bereft of sense, foolish.
E.
गत, and सङ्कल्प purpose.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Detached from, dissevered.
2 Adverse or indifferent to.
E.
गत, and सङ्ग union.

mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं)
1 Base.
2 Lifeless, dead, &c.
E.
गत, and सत्व being.

m. (-कः)
An elephant out of rut.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Blind, sightless.
E.
गत gone, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.

n. (-तं)
1 The flight of a bird backward and forward.
2 Going and coming, reiterated motion in general.
E.
गत going, आगत coming.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Following, imitating, imitative, doing as others do.
E.
गत, and अनुगतिक who goes after.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
1 Very old, infirm, decrepid, decayed.
2 Dead.
E.
गत, and आयुस् life.

f. (-वा)
1 A woman past child bearing.
2 A barren woman.
E.
गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Unmeaning, nonsensical.
2 Poor.
3 Void of an object.
E.
गत, and अर्थ sense, &c.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Dead, expired.
E.
गत, and असु breath.

f. (-तिः)
1 Going, moving, motion in general.
2 March, procession.
3 A road, a way, a path.
4 A period of life, as age, youth, &c.
5 An expedient^1, a means of success.
6 Knowledge, wisdom.
7 A sinus, a fistular sore.
8 Worldly vanity or wickedness.
9 Course of events, fate, fortune.
10 Resource, refuge, asylum.
11 The diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit.
12 State, mode of existence.
E.
गम to go, affix क्तिन.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-कं)
1 Going, motion.
2 Refuge, asylum.
3 Course.
4 Condition.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ला)
1 The name of a river, the Gatilā.
2 Mutual separation.
E.
गप्त to go, इल Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for the radical final.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going, moving, locomotive.
E.
गम to go, affix क्वरप्.

ind.
Having gone, gone to or attained, &c.
E.
गम to go, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Impassable, difficult of access.
2 Desert.
3 Helpless.
E.
गति, and ऊन् defective.

mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु)
Angry, wrathful.
m. (-तुः)
1 A Gandharba or celestial quirister.
2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
3 A large black bee.
4 A singer.
E.
गै to sing, Uṇādi affix तु.

mf. (-ता-त्री)
A male or female singer.
E.
गै to sing, तृच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The body.
2 The fore quarter of an elephant.
3 A limb, a member.
E.
गभ to go, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical final is rejected, and the vowel made long.

f. (-ङ्गा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
गात्र the body, and भङ्गा what breaks or hurts.

f. (-नी)
A towel.
E.
गात्र, and मार्जनी a wiper.

m. (-ची)
The pole-cat, (Viverra putorius.)
E.
गात्र the body, and सङ्कोचिन् who draws up or contracts in order to spring upon prey.

m. (-वः)
A small bird, the diver.
E.
गात्र the body, and सम्प्लव who plunges, from सम् entirely, प्लुङ् to go, and अच् aff.

f. (-नी)
Fragrant unguents, &c. smeared upon the body, perfume for the person.
E.
गात्र the body, अनु upon, लिप to plaster or smear, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Cleaning the person with perfumes, &c.
E.
गात्र, and उत्सादन cleaning.
